actions.title: Show file extensions
actions.summary: Make file types visible in Explorer. Captures this account's previous configuration before changing it.
actions.tradeoff: Names become longer. Configuration is verified; open a new Explorer window or sign out to check the visible result.

actions.title: Align the taskbar to the left
actions.summary: Move taskbar app buttons to the left for this account.
actions.tradeoff: Changes your navigation habit. Windows may need a shell refresh or sign-out before the visual result appears.

actions.title: Hide the Task View button
actions.summary: Hide the taskbar shortcut while retaining virtual desktops and keyboard access.
actions.tradeoff: Use Win+Tab to open Task View. A later shell refresh may be necessary.

actions.title: Turn off transparency effects
actions.summary: Use more opaque Windows surfaces without changing animations or accessibility settings.
actions.tradeoff: An appearance preference, with no guaranteed performance gain. Verify the visible effect after sign-out if necessary.

actions.title: Reduce suggested content in Settings
actions.summary: Set this account's Settings suggestion preference. Other advertising and notification choices remain independent.
actions.tradeoff: Build-dependent preference. Reading the saved value does not prove all future suggestions are suppressed.

actions.title: Turn off the advertising ID preference
actions.summary: Disable this account's advertising ID preference for apps that respect it.
actions.tradeoff: Does not block browser tracking or remove all advertising. Undo restores configuration, not an old identifier.

actions.title: Startup impact explorer
actions.summary: Inventory user startup entries, publisher, path, enabled state and observed contribution. Link to Settings/Task Manager; optional Autoruns expert inspection. Startup controls
actions.tradeoff: Compare repeated sign-in-to-usable-desktop times. No mutation during scan.

actions.title: Selective startup suppression
actions.summary: Use app-native startup control or a validated per-user adapter. Preserve antivirus, backup, accessibility, password managers and device utilities unless specifically selected. Startup controls
actions.tradeoff: Relaunch app and test intended features; restore exact enabled state. Delay is separately labeled from disable.

actions.title: Background workload diagnosis
actions.summary: Rank sustained CPU/I/O/network/GPU work, not number of processes. WPR/WPA escalation identifies the responsible process/driver. WPR
actions.tradeoff: Compare the same foreground task and sample duration; no automatic process killing.

actions.title: App background permissions
actions.summary: Limit selected unused app background activity in its Settings page. Notifications/sync may change. Windows performance guidance
actions.benefit: Opt-in, apps exposing a supported control
actions.tradeoff: Check notification/sync behavior and foreground launch time; restore previous policy.

actions.title: Browser/extension triage
actions.summary: Identify browser resource use and guide to its own task manager, extensions and sleep/background settings; do not edit opaque profile databases.
actions.tradeoff: Compare real tab set, cold/warm launch and memory pressure; undo within browser. Browser/version-specific research required before automation.

actions.title: Search workload correction
actions.summary: Preserve Search service. Review Classic/Enhanced and indexed folders; exclude only user-selected high-churn paths. Search performance
actions.tradeoff: Search known documents/mail and monitor contention; restore scope. Reindexing takes time and is not routine cleanup.

actions.title: Storage pressure and large-item explorer
actions.summary: Show bytes by volume/category, app/game locations and reclaim estimates. Prefer Storage cleanup surfaces. Storage settings
actions.benefit: Default scan, delete only selected categories
actions.tradeoff: Report actual freed bytes separately from speed. Deletion has no optimizer undo unless files were explicitly quarantined.

actions.title: Conservative Storage Sense
actions.summary: Show full retention policy; default proposed Downloads cleanup and cloud dehydration off, and make Recycle Bin retention explicit. Storage Sense
actions.tradeoff: Check saved rules; changing rules is reversible, already-deleted content is not.

actions.title: SSD/HDD maintenance readiness
actions.summary: Verify media mapping, TRIM and scheduled Optimize Drives; invoke supported maintenance only when indicated. Windows handles media-appropriate optimization. Storage settings
actions.tradeoff: Check supported status/results; no claim that repeated TRIM boosts FPS. Avoid invalid disk joins based solely on friendly name.

actions.title: Game storage/DirectStorage readiness
actions.summary: Detect actual game drive and game support; use launcher's move feature to move selected games. DirectStorage must be implemented by the game. DirectStorage
actions.tradeoff: Compare repeatable loading/streaming; moving back is conditional on space and launcher support. Never offer an “enable DirectStorage” registry switch.

actions.title: Component-store analysis
actions.summary: Analyze before proposing supported cleanup. Keep repair operations separate from performance profiles.
actions.tradeoff: Verify servicing outcome/space reclaimed. No ordinary preset performs ResetBase or destroys previous-OS rollback.

actions.title: Driver and health diagnosis
actions.summary: Detect failed devices/basic display drivers, record versions, link to Windows Update/OEM/vendor. DISM/SFC belong to symptom-driven repair.
actions.tradeoff: Retest original fault; establish the supported driver rollback route before replacement. No bulk driver-updater installation.

actions.title: Windowed-game optimizations
actions.summary: Supported Graphics setting changes presentation path; provide per-game exceptions. Auto HDR has a dependency on this setting. Windowed games
actions.benefit: Recommended proposal, compatible DX10/11 windowed/borderless games
actions.tradeoff: Compare frame delivery and compatibility; restore previous global/per-app state and restart game.

actions.title: Correct GPU selection
actions.summary: Guide to per-app graphics preference when a game uses the wrong GPU. Windowed games
actions.tradeoff: Check actual GPU use plus performance/power; restore Windows-decides or exact prior preference.

actions.title: Refresh-rate mismatch detector
actions.summary: Compare current mode to supported modes at the current resolution. Explain mode/bandwidth/battery tradeoffs. Refresh rate
actions.tradeoff: User-visible confirmation and timed mode recovery; restore full prior mode, not refresh alone.

actions.title: VRR/DRR/HDR/Auto HDR
actions.summary: Expose supported capabilities; separate smoothness/appearance from FPS. DRR can cap some non-VRR games. Refresh rate, Auto HDR
actions.tradeoff: Check image, tearing, game refresh and battery; restore prior state. No blanket “HDR off for speed.”

actions.title: Preserve Game Mode/Game Bar
actions.summary: Keep supported scheduling/game integrations. Detect AMD chipset/CPU dependencies and keep capture preference separate from package removal. AMD setup
actions.tradeoff: Test game launch, overlay, capture and supported scheduling behavior; no action if already correct.

actions.title: HAGS comparison
actions.summary: Use exposed Graphics setting; retain current state until measured. GPU scheduling documentation does not prove a universal FPS gain. Graphics settings
actions.tradeoff: Reboot as needed; fixed scene/driver/settings A/B/A; restore exact state. Note metric limitations under HAGS.

actions.title: Overlay/capture comparison
actions.summary: Temporarily disable selected recording/overlay features within their own supported controls. Presence alone is not a defect.
actions.tradeoff: Compare frame-time distribution and recording/voice needs; restore per-app settings. Keep Game Bar installed if platform needs it.

actions.title: In-game latency features
actions.summary: Offer NVIDIA Reflex or AMD Anti-Lag guidance for the identified title; no injected helpers or anti-cheat bypass. NVIDIA Reflex, AMD Anti-Lag
actions.benefit: Guided opt-in, supported GPU and game
actions.tradeoff: Measure supported latency metrics and frame pacing; undo in game/driver. Never copy vendor marketing percentages as a prediction.

actions.title: FPS limits and graphics quality
actions.summary: Use game-native controls for the user's target responsiveness, image quality and noise. Upscaling and generated frames must be disclosed as quality/latency tradeoffs.
actions.tradeoff: Fixed scene; separate application/render FPS from displayed/generated FPS. Restore exact game settings.

actions.title: Frame-time analysis
actions.summary: Integrate a pinned optional PresentMon capture tool with explicit process selection and bounded duration. PresentMon
actions.tradeoff: Report median/p95/p99 frame times, long frames and sample count. Record tool version/API/HAGS caveats; no benchmark injection.

actions.title: Audio/DPC diagnosis
actions.summary: Optional LatencyMon or WPR capture, then device/driver-specific investigation. A high DPC value is a clue, not measured input-to-photon latency.
actions.tradeoff: Reproduce audio/workload fault and verify it disappears; don't disable devices/services en masse.

actions.title: Mouse/input preferences
actions.summary: Native pointer speed/precision and vendor-supported polling settings; no FPS claim. Preserve accessibility and user sensitivity. Mouse settings
actions.tradeoff: Validate real input in relevant games/apps; restore exact prior state. High polling-rate experiments measure CPU/frame-time effects.

actions.title: Commit/pressure dashboard
actions.summary: Sample commit/limit, paging, hard faults, working sets and physical/cache composition. Pagefile, RAMMap
actions.tradeoff: Judge foreground latency and failures; “free RAM” alone is not a win. No cache clearing.

actions.title: Pagefile correctness
actions.summary: Consider measured peak commit plus dump requirements, existing volumes and free space. Pagefile
actions.benefit: Preserve; recommend system management when an artificial cap is causing pressure
actions.tradeoff: Confirm after reboot, repeat pressure workload, restore prior complete multi-volume configuration if selected. Never size only by installed RAM.

actions.title: Compression/SysMain preservation
actions.summary: Do not disable these because RAM exceeds a threshold or the OS disk is SSD. The legacy heuristics have no validated benefit here.
actions.tradeoff: Only a separately scoped troubleshooting experiment could justify a change; check warm launches and paging, not cached-RAM screenshots.

actions.title: Power-mode experiment
actions.summary: Compare supported Balanced/current and Best performance mode; preserve OEM control and existing plan. Performance guidance
actions.tradeoff: Sustained workload, temperatures, power and noise; restore old plan/settings. No repeated duplication or unpark-all.

actions.title: Thermal/power-limit diagnosis
actions.summary: Show sustained clocks, temperatures and limit flags with provider confidence; unknown sensors stay unknown. Adaptive scheduling must remain intact. Intel hybrid guidance
actions.benefit: Default diagnostic where reliable sensors exist; manual remediation
actions.tradeoff: Repeat sustained workload after a specific correction. Cooling, fans, hardware service and firmware remain manual.

actions.title: Sleep/hibernate/Fast Startup
actions.summary: Diagnose actual sleep/resume and boot behavior. Hibernation availability is a user workflow choice, not an automatic disk-cleanup target.
actions.tradeoff: Test restart, shutdown/boot, sleep/resume and peripherals separately; restore captured power/hibernate state.

actions.title: SleepStudy and battery reports
actions.summary: Bounded native reports identify standby activity and battery trends; use WPR escalation when needed. SleepStudy
actions.tradeoff: Repeated representative sleep intervals, resume functionality and drain; no permanent monitoring by default.

actions.title: DNS/network-path diagnosis
actions.summary: Separate DNS lookup, local link, router, Internet path and remote service. Preserve existing DNS/DHCP by default.
actions.tradeoff: Repeated cached/uncached DNS tests, packet RTT/loss under load and connectivity. Restore prior per-adapter IPv4/IPv6/DHCP state.

actions.title: NIC moderation/offload experiment
actions.summary: Expose documented property values and tradeoffs, not English-name assumptions. Latency and CPU/throughput objectives can conflict. NIC tuning
actions.tradeoff: Compare host CPU, throughput, loss and loaded latency; restore exact previous values. No changes on remote-use link without recovery.

actions.title: Router/Wi-Fi guidance
actions.summary: Use measured signal/link loss/loaded latency to suggest Ethernet, placement/channel or router queue-management investigation.
actions.tradeoff: Repeat same endpoints/load; record topology. Do not claim a Windows registry change fixes upstream congestion.

actions.title: CPU affinity/priority experiments
actions.summary: Prefer application fixes; avoid hard affinities on hybrid CPUs. No automatic Process Lasso rules or priority boosts. Intel guidance, Scheduling priorities
actions.benefit: Expert experiment only, demonstrated scheduler contention
actions.tradeoff: Per-title A/B/A with throughput, frame pacing and background functionality; restore all process settings. Realtime priority excluded.

actions.title: Hardware upgrade/readiness advisor
actions.summary: Identify an actual storage, RAM-capacity, cooling or display constraint before suggesting purchases or firmware changes.
actions.tradeoff: State expected affected workload, uncertainty and physical/vendor checks. No automated BIOS flash, overclock, undervolt, XMP/EXPO or security disabling.

actions.title: Show file extensions
actions.summary: Explorer → View → Show → File name extensions. Candidate for a qualified user-scope provider; guided fallback. Extensions
actions.tradeoff: Longer visible names; helps recognize file types but is not malware protection. Verify representative files in Explorer. Restore the captured preference.

actions.title: Explorer landing page
actions.summary: Explorer Options → Open File Explorer to → Home or This PC where available. Guide/Candidate. Explorer
actions.tradeoff: Changes navigation habit and recent/cloud discovery. Reopen Explorer to verify; restore exact previous target.

actions.title: Frequent folders and tabs
actions.summary: Use native pinning and Explorer tabs on compatible builds. Guide. Explorer, Shortcuts
actions.benefit: Usability; Opt-in folders, educational tips available by default
actions.tradeoff: Never infer private folders or replace existing pins. Verify chosen destination; removing a new pin is different from reconstructing an entire previous layout.

actions.title: Hidden files and preview pane
actions.summary: Native Explorer controls; preserve protected-system-file hiding. Guide. Explorer
actions.tradeoff: Preview capability depends on installed handlers and trust restrictions. Do not bypass preview protections; restore preferences without deleting handlers.

actions.title: Extended context-menu commands
actions.summary: Native Show more options and keyboard reference. Guide. Explorer
actions.tradeoff: No legacy-menu registry patch or Explorer injection in defaults. Verify required app command remains accessible.

actions.title: Index scope review
actions.summary: Windows Search settings / Advanced indexing options. Guide initially. Indexing
actions.benefit: Usability/resource hygiene; Recommend assessment, exclusions Opt-in
actions.tradeoff: Exclusions can make searches incomplete; show exact paths and file types. Verify representative filename/content searches after index settles; restore scope.

actions.title: Enhanced search choice
actions.summary: Classic/Enhanced or current equivalent when exposed. Guide. Indexing
actions.tradeoff: Wider indexing consumes resources; account for laptop use and initial indexing. Restore prior mode, allowing index rebuild time.

actions.title: Default-app repair
actions.summary: Windows Default apps page; documented per-app link where supported. Guide, not association-database rewriting. Settings URI
actions.tradeoff: Changes affect opening files/links. Test a sample file; guide back to the recorded prior choice. Do not promise an automated undo without a qualified provider.

actions.title: Optional fast filename search
actions.summary: Optional Everything integration, qualified separately in PUBLIC-TOOLS.md.
actions.tradeoff: Extra software/index/service choices need disclosure. It complements content/app search; do not disable Windows Search because it was installed.

actions.title: Taskbar alignment/search presentation
actions.summary: Personalization → Taskbar. Guide/Candidate only for qualified individual preferences. Taskbar
actions.tradeoff: Preserve the user's navigation habits. Check taskbar and keyboard search; restore old values. No FPS claim.

actions.title: Widgets and Task View entry points
actions.summary: Documented taskbar switches. Guide/Candidate. Taskbar
actions.benefit: Appearance; Opt-in, suggested in Minimal Distraction
actions.tradeoff: Hiding an entry point is not package removal or proof that background work stopped. Verify visibility; restore exact state.

actions.title: Start pins, folders and recommendations
actions.summary: Personalization → Start and native pin controls. Guide, version-specific controls only. Start
actions.tradeoff: Reduces convenient recent-item discovery. Do not rewrite layout databases or impose an invented default layout. Verify visible results; guided restoration unless exact layout capture is supported.

actions.title: Windows tips/welcome interruption
actions.summary: System → Notifications → Additional settings. Guide/Candidate. Notifications
actions.tradeoff: Less onboarding help. Restore previous toggles; distinguish value readback from proving a future welcome screen will not appear.

actions.title: Notification sender review
actions.summary: Per-app banners, sounds and notification-center preferences. Guide initially. Notifications
actions.tradeoff: Missed messages/alarms are possible. Preview each sender; test important workflows and restore that sender's configuration.

actions.title: Lock-screen content privacy
actions.summary: Hide sensitive notification content using exposed controls. Guide/Candidate. Notifications
actions.tradeoff: Less glanceable information. Test with a harmless notification while locked; restore the prior choice.

actions.title: Do Not Disturb rules
actions.summary: Automatic game/full-screen/schedule rules and priority exceptions. Guide. Notifications
actions.tradeoff: Important banners may be silenced. Test exceptions, notification-center delivery and automatic exit; restore all changed rules.

actions.title: Focus sessions
actions.summary: Native Focus/Clock workflow. Guide. Focus
actions.tradeoff: User chooses session duration and breaks. No service disabling or permanent notification kill switch. End the session and restore changed preferences.

actions.title: Snap configuration
actions.summary: System → Multitasking; Win+Z tips. Guide/Candidate. Snap
actions.tradeoff: Some users dislike individual snap gestures. Check actual window placement; restore only selected behavior.

actions.title: Monitor reconnect behavior
actions.summary: Display → Multiple displays → remember positions/minimize on disconnect. Guide. Monitors
actions.tradeoff: Depends on display topology and apps. Test undock/reconnect; preserve scaling, orientation and primary display. Restore original preferences.

actions.title: Virtual desktops
actions.summary: Task View and Multitasking preferences. Guide with shortcuts. Shortcuts
actions.tradeoff: No automatic desktop creation or relocation of open apps. Verify current/all-desktop behavior; manual restoration when layout reconstruction is unsupported.

actions.title: Local clipboard history
actions.summary: System → Clipboard / Win+V. Guide. Clipboard
actions.tradeoff: Copied private material can remain accessible. Show local history separately from cloud sync; restore preference, not deleted history.

actions.title: Cross-device clipboard
actions.summary: Clipboard sync and automatic/manual sync choice. Account-dependent. Guide. Clipboard
actions.benefit: Convenience/cloud privacy tradeoff; Opt-in, Privacy proposes off
actions.tradeoff: Explain cloud transfer/account scope. Verify configured mode; turning sync off cannot undo data already transferred.

actions.title: Clear clipboard history
actions.summary: Native clear controls; Guide/API candidate only after scope validation. Clipboard
actions.tradeoff: Destructive; pinned items require separate review. Do not capture clipboard contents in optimizer logs or backups. No content undo.

actions.title: Text size, scale and pointer visibility
actions.summary: Native Accessibility and Display pages. Guide. Visibility, Resolution, Mouse
actions.tradeoff: Preview readability and layout; never reset accessibility with a gaming profile. Restore full previous values; keep UI operable at high DPI.

actions.title: Animation/transparency preferences
actions.summary: Accessibility visual effects and documented personalization controls. Guide/Candidate. Focus
actions.tradeoff: Reduced motion may be preferable; transparency is a visual preference. No automatic benchmark gain claimed. Verify visible effect and restore prior state.

actions.title: Night light/brightness/color
actions.summary: Display settings, supported hardware only. Guide. Color
actions.tradeoff: Color-sensitive work may require different choices. Test image and schedule; restore exact prior values. HDR/refresh performance belongs in the performance catalog.

actions.title: Mouse behavior
actions.summary: Pointer speed/precision, button assignment, scrolling and visibility in native settings. Guide/Candidate. Mouse
actions.tradeoff: Preserve sensitivity, handedness and accessibility. Check intended app behavior; restore all selected values. No universal gaming acceleration prescription.

actions.title: Sound output and volume workflow
actions.summary: Native Sound/volume mixer; Win+Ctrl+V where supported. Guide. Shortcuts
actions.benefit: Usability; Opt-in, shortcut education by default
actions.tradeoff: Device changes can affect calls, capture and games differently. Verify playback/mic selection in those apps; restore previous endpoints, without deleting audio devices.

actions.title: Selective PowerToys modules
actions.summary: Official PowerToys settings; version qualification in PUBLIC-TOOLS.md. PowerToys
actions.benefit: Usability; Opt-in install and module choices
actions.tradeoff: Extra resident processes, shortcuts and updates. Measure footprint if relevant; preserve existing configuration, disable selected modules or uninstall via normal route.

actions.title: Shortcut reference
actions.summary: Searchable small set for Explorer, Snap, screenshots, audio and desktops. Shortcuts
actions.tradeoff: Show availability and existing remappings. Do not overwrite user shortcuts to match a preset.

actions.title: Advertising/personalization review
actions.summary: Privacy & security → General or Recommendations & offers, according to actual build. Guide. General privacy
actions.tradeoff: Turning off advertising ID does not remove all ads or browser tracking. Read effective setting; restore preference without claiming recovery of the previous identifier.

actions.title: Optional diagnostics/feedback review
actions.summary: Diagnostics & feedback. Guide, edition/policy-aware. Diagnostics
actions.tradeoff: Reduces optional reporting, not all Windows data transmission. Required data and security remain. Verify setting; past transfers cannot be undone.

actions.title: App diagnostics permission
actions.summary: App diagnostics page, per account/app where exposed. Guide. App diagnostics
actions.tradeoff: Some diagnostic app features may stop working; desktop apps are not governed by this control. Test chosen workflow and restore permission.

actions.title: Camera/microphone access audit
actions.summary: Separate device access, app permissions, desktop-app access and browser site permissions. Guide. Camera/microphone
actions.tradeoff: Calls/recording/dictation may break. Do not describe the list as exhaustive. Test the actual selected application; restore the exact permission level.

actions.title: Location and Find My Device
actions.summary: Native Location settings plus Find My Device review. Guide. Location
actions.tradeoff: Disabling location can affect device finding, automatic time zone and some Wi-Fi information access. Show conflicts first; restore permission and test intended features.

actions.title: Browser permission handoff
actions.summary: Browser-native site-permission controls. Guide, browser/version-specific. Camera/microphone
actions.tradeoff: Do not edit browser profile databases, extension stores or certificates. Verify chosen site's call/permission flow; restore its previous permission if desired.

actions.title: OneDrive/Windows Backup awareness
actions.summary: Display sync/backup configuration and open official apps/settings. Guide. Backup, OneDrive
actions.tradeoff: Cloud storage/account availability matters; sync can propagate deletions. Do not treat the presence of a sync client as proof that files are backed up. No silent unlink/removal.

actions.title: Recall state and controls
actions.summary: Native Recall & snapshots; keep Windows Hello authorization in Windows. Guide. Recall privacy
actions.benefit: Privacy/usability; Preserve current state (off stays off), changes Opt-in
actions.tradeoff: Show unsupported/absent/unknown separately. Separate saving, filters, retention and deletion. Changing a toggle is not a guarantee that all sensitive material is excluded.

actions.title: Recall optional-feature removal
actions.summary: Supported Windows optional-feature UI; automate only after exact servicing contract qualifies. Guide/API candidate. Recall removal
actions.tradeoff: Removal deletes saved snapshots; re-enabling the feature does not restore them. Machine-wide feature operation must show all affected users. Never classify as exact undo.

actions.title: Copilot/AI app entry points
actions.summary: Detect actual installed app and supported pin/uninstall controls. Guide, no old universal registry key. Start, App removal
actions.tradeoff: Unpin, uninstall app and disable other AI functionality are distinct actions. Preserve unrelated apps, runtimes and NPU drivers. Verify exact selected scope; reinstall is conditional.

actions.title: Storage overview and cleanup preview
actions.summary: Native Storage categories/cleanup recommendations; bounded optimizer-owned scan later. Guide/API candidate. Storage
actions.tradeoff: Estimated bytes differ from actual reclaimable space. Never select Downloads, Recycle Bin or previous Windows install implicitly; verify actual free-space change. Deleted content has no general undo.

actions.title: Storage Sense retention
actions.summary: System → Storage → Storage Sense. Capture actual retention/cloud settings. Guide initially. Storage Sense
actions.tradeoff: Recurring deletion or online-only conversion is consequential. Show each category; restore configuration, not files already deleted.

actions.title: OneDrive offline availability
actions.summary: Free up space versus Always keep on this device. Guide. OneDrive
actions.tradeoff: Online-only files need connectivity; content search differs. Check sync/availability and known-folder protection before changes. Rehydration needs account access, network and space.

actions.title: Startup-app review
actions.summary: Apps → Startup / Task Manager and application controls. Guide/Candidate. See performance catalog.
actions.benefit: Startup/background performance potential; Recommend audit, changes Opt-in
actions.tradeoff: Preserve security, accessibility, sync and peripheral needs. Verify login/workflows, not merely entry disappearance; restore prior launch configuration.

actions.title: Active hours and restart scheduling
actions.summary: Windows Update → Advanced options → Active hours; exposed restart scheduler. Guide. Active hours, Update FAQ
actions.tradeoff: Do not overwrite a chosen manual schedule with Automatic. Verify configured schedule; cancellation/restoration cannot reverse a restart already performed.

actions.title: Temporary update pause
actions.summary: Native Windows Update pause when available. Guide. Update FAQ
actions.tradeoff: Delays protection; show end/resume date and management constraints. Preserve update services; resume using native control.

actions.title: Recovery readiness
actions.summary: Recovery/Windows Backup pages; distinguish System Restore, WinRE, file backup and newer available recovery options. Guide/API assessment. Recovery, Backup
actions.tradeoff: Backup registration is not evidence of a tested restore. Do not collect recovery keys into logs. Recovery configuration changes require their own preview; no guaranteed system rollback badge.

actions.title: Installed-app review
actions.summary: Current-user Installed apps / official package APIs after qualification. API/Guide. App removal
actions.tradeoff: Show exact identity, data risk, scope and reinstall route; never auto-remove merely because bundled. Reinstall rarely restores all app state.

actions.title: Large files and redundant tools
actions.summary: Bounded file-size view/optional disk visualizer; tool choices in PUBLIC-TOOLS.md.
actions.tradeoff: Size/age alone is not evidence a file is unwanted. Exclude reparse traversal by default, preserve cloud placeholders, avoid destructive duplicate-file heuristics.

actions.title: Microsoft PowerToys
actions.summary: Window layouts, quick file previews and selected productivity utilities.
actions.tradeoff: Opens the official publisher page. Nothing is downloaded, installed or run automatically. Review publisher terms and background overhead.

actions.title: Autoruns
actions.summary: Inspect startup items with Microsoft Sysinternals; changes require your review.
actions.tradeoff: Opens the official publisher page. Nothing is downloaded, installed or run automatically. Review publisher terms and background overhead.

actions.title: Process Explorer
actions.summary: Investigate process resource use and ownership.
actions.tradeoff: Opens the official publisher page. Nothing is downloaded, installed or run automatically. Review publisher terms and background overhead.

actions.title: RAMMap
actions.summary: Understand memory use; routine cache flushing is not an optimization.
actions.tradeoff: Opens the official publisher page. Nothing is downloaded, installed or run automatically. Review publisher terms and background overhead.

actions.title: Everything
actions.summary: Fast filename search that complements Windows Search.
actions.tradeoff: Opens the official publisher page. Nothing is downloaded, installed or run automatically. Review publisher terms and background overhead.

actions.title: WinDirStat
actions.summary: Find large folders before choosing what to remove.
actions.tradeoff: Opens the official publisher page. Nothing is downloaded, installed or run automatically. Review publisher terms and background overhead.

actions.title: PresentMon
actions.summary: Measure frame presentation for a repeatable game workload.
actions.tradeoff: Opens the official publisher page. Nothing is downloaded, installed or run automatically. Review publisher terms and background overhead.

actions.title: CapFrameX
actions.summary: Analyze controlled frame-time captures.
actions.tradeoff: Opens the official publisher page. Nothing is downloaded, installed or run automatically. Review publisher terms and background overhead.

actions.title: LatencyMon
actions.summary: Investigate a reproducible audio or DPC latency problem.
actions.tradeoff: Opens the official publisher page. Nothing is downloaded, installed or run automatically. Review publisher terms and background overhead.

actions.title: Bulk Crap Uninstaller
actions.summary: Optional advanced uninstall manager; review every deletion.
actions.tradeoff: Opens the official publisher page. Nothing is downloaded, installed or run automatically. Review publisher terms and background overhead.

actions.title: Win11Debloat
actions.summary: Reviewed candidate for a future restricted adapter. This build opens upstream documentation only.
actions.tradeoff: Opens the official publisher page. Nothing is downloaded, installed or run automatically. Review publisher terms and background overhead.

actions.title: Windows Performance Toolkit
actions.summary: Advanced recordings and analysis for startup, CPU and storage bottlenecks.
actions.tradeoff: Opens the official publisher page. Nothing is downloaded, installed or run automatically. Review publisher terms and background overhead.
